app_info.subtitle: Find the nearest public toilet
app_info.description: Find public toilets worldwide. Shows distance, walk time, access rule, fee, opening state and wheelchair access, with a map link. Needs a place name or coordinates. Does not request precise user location. Toilet data is © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches stored public toilet records. It does not change them. Service caches can refresh.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the Loonaut toilet data set. The place lookup returns coordinates and publishes nothing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite user records, publish messages, create bookings or transfer money.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one stored public toilet record. It does not change it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the Loonaut toilet data set.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite user records, publish messages, create bookings or transfer money.

test_cases.description: Find the nearest toilet to a named place.
test_cases.user_prompt: Where is the nearest public toilet to Darmstadt Hauptbahnhof?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists toilets sorted by distance with walk time, access rule and opening state. Shows the OpenStreetMap credit. Does not invent a toilet.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find a free, wheelchair-accessible public toilet with a changing table near Köln Dom.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only toilets that match the filters. Says so when no toilet matches. Does not relax a filter without telling the user.

test_cases.description: Ask a follow-up about one toilet.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a public toilet near Piazza Navona in Rome, then tell me when the first one is open and whether it costs money.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports hours, access rule and fee of the first result. Says unknown when the data is unknown. Shows the last confirmation date.

test_cases.description: Ask for a location when the request has none.
test_cases.user_prompt: I need a public toilet right now.
test_cases.expected_output: Asks the user for a street, station or town. Does not ask for GPS coordinates.

test_cases.description: Search with coordinates the user gave.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the closest public toilet to latitude 52.5208 and longitude 13.4095.
test_cases.expected_output: Searches with the given coordinates. Lists toilets by distance with walk time and shows the OpenStreetMap credit.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for toilet products.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Which toilet seat should I buy for my bathroom?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked for toilet products or plumbing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for restaurant search.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Recommend a good restaurant near Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked for restaurants or other places.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger outside the toilet workflow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my accountant about my tax return.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked for email or tax tasks.
